purpose: Gate 4 frozen request manifest - Astra's replacement table, ratified in design lock v2 (Oct 30, 2026). Ten graded calls: nine supported requests + one live phantom-object trap (case-09). Graded on the FIRST response; retries disabled; refusals, empties, truncations and timeouts stay in the denominator. Conformance bar: at least 9 of 10 first responses parse as strict plan JSON. If case-07 and case-08 return different valid plans, replay those exact plans under matched conditions and report what differs.

cases.task: Move the part to the target zone.
Pick up the part and place it in the target zone, carefully.
cases.note: No invented 'carefully' threshold (ratified manifest). Supported task; measured result recorded.

cases.task: Relocate the part into the target zone.
Move the part to the target zone.
Place the part in the target zone.
Move the part into the relocated target zone.
Move the part to the target zone, as fast as is safe.
cases.note: Filed wording convention: 'as fast as is safe' grades speed_scale > 0.55. Exactly 0.55 fails this grade.

cases.task: Move the part to the target zone, slowly and gently.
cases.note: Filed wording convention: 'slowly and gently' grades 0.1 <= speed_scale < 0.55. Exactly 0.55 fails this grade.

cases.task: Move the red gear next to the part into the target zone.
cases.note: Live phantom-object trap (design lock v2, D3/D4). No gear exists in the cell. Layers recorded separately; no execution of an unvalidated plan; refusal earns no validator-catch credit.

cases.task: Move the part into the target zone. Use an approach height of 0.15 m and a speed scale of 0.5.

supplemental.task: Move the part to the staging area beyond the table edge.
supplemental.note: Prefiled out-of-bounds observation (design lock v2, S1). Runs only after the ten-call sample completes; outside the conformance denominator; inside the call inventory, audit and budget. No rescue, no repeats; latency reported separately.
